limitations: Current-survivor proxy universe; not a point-in-time ETF universe.
Yahoo auto-adjusted prices are a total-return proxy, not issuer NAV authority.
Macro and event snapshots are prospective context only; holdings, futures-curve, FX and tax inputs are absent.

methodology.curve: month-end historical observations in the same 10-point opportunity-score band
methodology.downside_risk: positioning-unwind watch requires prior 58-session gain >=15%, 5-session loss >=6%, relative loss versus SPY >=4%, and 21-session drawdown >=9%; only a material negative event upgrades it to downside bias
methodology.final_score: price score plus bounded fresh catalysts, decaying persistent sentiment, historical analogs, risk, and state-transition inputs; repeated coverage cannot multiply one theme
methodology.opportunity: 75% cross-sectional 21/63/126-session total-return momentum rank + 25% positive-trend confirmation
methodology.risk: equal-weight cross-sectional 63-session volatility and 126-session drawdown ranks

ENERGY_SUPPLY.rationale: Material global supply changes: Bahrain intercepts Iranian attacks amid oil-tanker blockade breach plan, new US sanctions on Iranian oil traders (2 reports), ADNOC-Gujarat 10-yr LNG deal, Sabine Pass LNG expansion approved, Bay du Nord regulatory clearance, North Sea field approvals, Oman $400m gas deal, and polar vortex gas-price risk. HEALTH_POLICY.rationale: Policy state changes: NC Medicaid expansion, Medicare Part B premium to $209.40, UnitedHealth Medicare Advantage star-rating $100m fraud settlement, nine-state Medicaid cuts risk, Alzheimer's ASAP Act coverage, Medicaid work-requirement pauses, FDA dexmedetomidine approval, CMS pharmacy contracting RFI.

MILITARY_GEOPOLITICS.rationale: Verified state changes with global transmission: Iranian strikes on US bases in Bahrain (corroborated by 3 reports), Russian missiles landing in Poland/NATO violation, Baltic drone attack on Russian cargo ship, Hamas-Fatah unity declaration, UK sanctions on West Bank settlement firms, Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, Lebanese president demands, and Yemeni drone attacks on Saudi troops. Omitted speculation, sports, local crime and promo content.

MONETARY_INFLATION.rationale: Verified CPI/price data across major economies: UK inflation at multi-year low (with energy-driven 3.6% detail), Pakistan inflation tripling to 10.41%, US jobs report with real-wage erosion, South Africa above-target path, Nigeria food inflation, slowing core inflation, Ghana PPI, Norway CPI unchanged. Excluded political and personal-finance noise.

POLITICAL_SOCIAL_SHOCK.rationale: Significant shocks: Peru M6.7 quake (with resident-flee report), US government shutdown deal averted (2 reports), Romania M5.3, China M5.9, Liberia presidential concession, Canada Northwest Territories wildfire crisis, Central Europe flood deaths. Excluded minor quakes and local flood/wildfire items.

PRECIOUS_METALS.rationale: Distinct bullion events: worst-week gold/silver selloff on hawkish Fed (5 corroborating reports), China's 24-month central-bank buying, Pakistan halting KP gold mining, Goldman 4-5 sigma margin-call signal, silver down 16% with commodities, Pakistan per-tola price slide, and Modi's demand-reduction effect. Excluded sports medals and crime stories.

TECHNOLOGY_AI.rationale: Material policy/market changes: Taiwan emergency chip-market measures, Treasury rules allowing Nvidia chip exports, BIS semiconductor remote-access rule, $130bn Google data center bond, Trump's overseas data-center tax proposal, Democrats' public-lands data-center ban, Vietnam data-center tariffs, AI financing concerns. Excluded stock picks and product promos.

TRADE_CONTROLS.rationale: Authoritative trade state changes: Supreme Court rejection of global tariffs, EU-Indonesia deal signed (corroborated by tariff-scope detail), Canada 100% EV tariff, EU defense against US Airbus tariffs, $28.5bn tariff refunds (2 reports), ASEAN summit tariff focus. Only six distinct warrantable events.
